*|area fill: Draws a color-filled area mark on the sheet, not a measurement.
*|arrow: Draws a simple arrow mark on the sheet that is not part of the measurements.
*|batch overlay: Matches sheet pairs and applies overlays to many sheets of the job at once.
*|cloud: Draws a cloud mark on the sheet to flag changes.
*|count points at line ends: Places Count points at the ends of the selected lines, a separate Count for each takeoff.
*|create line grid: Builds a grid of lines inside an area at a set horizontal and vertical spacing.
*|crop hints: Draws the sheet number, title and scale areas for auto-naming and `AI Fill`.
*|crop to sheet: Copies framed details from different sheets onto one sheet at true scale.
*|draw line: Draws a simple line mark on the sheet that is not part of the measurements.
*|go to page: Opens the sheet the selected entry, observation or measurement belongs to.
*|hide area (white): Covers part of the sheet with solid white on screen and in the PDF export.
*|highlighter: Draws a semi-transparent highlighter mark on the sheet that is not part of the measurements.
*|note: Writes a text note at the chosen spot on the sheet.
*|open crop: Opens the crop image that an AI entry or observation was made from.
*|open details: Opens the details window of the selected AI entry.
*|project data recovery: Restores damaged job files from a verified copy.
*|properties: Opens the properties of the selected takeoff for editing.
*|run ai: Sends the request of the selected entry or observation to the AI.
*|save as: Saves the current job to a new location on disk.
*|settings → terminals: Opens the `Terminals` settings section with the Claude and Codex profiles.
*|show overlay: Shows or hides the overlaid sheet or overlay layer.
*|trace walls inside area: Traces the walls inside the selected area as linear measurements by thickness and minimum length.
*|wall: Builds 3D walls from the selected linear takeoffs and measurements.

f1|nudge the overlay: Shifts the overlaid sheet by a small step with the arrows and `Ctrl+Alt`.
f1|open name / scale: Opens the window for setting the active sheet's name and scale by hand.
f1|open the selected bookmark / ai entry: Opens the selected bookmark or `AI Inbox` entry on its sheet.
f1|range / toggle selection: Selects a range with a `Shift` click, adds or removes a row with a `Ctrl` click.
f1|remove from selection: Removes objects from the selection with a click or a box while the keys are held.
f1|rotate the overlay: Rotates the overlaid sheet with the square brackets and `Ctrl+Alt`.
f1|scale the overlay: Enlarges or shrinks the overlaid sheet with the plus and minus keys and `Ctrl+Alt`.
f1|select a range: Selects a range of rows from the previous selection with a `Shift` click.
f1|select vertices / handles: Selects measurement vertices and handles with a click or a box while the key is held.
f1|set scale on selected sheet(s): Sets one scale on the selected sheets or on the active sheet.
f1|start marquee selection from a row: Starts a box selection in the tree by dragging from a row with `Alt`.
f1|temporarily force ortho: Turns on `Ortho` mode while the key is held during drawing or editing.
f1|toggle one row: Adds one row to the selection or removes it with a `Ctrl` click.
f1|use fine movement / scale / rotation: Makes the overlay shift, scale and rotation finer when `Shift` is added.
file.autoLinkExcel: DFL only: links right away the takeoffs whose numbers already sit in the `J:L` list. Cells do not change, a window shows the result.
file.blankJob: Creates an empty OurPlanCore job without picking a PDF.
file.excelLinks: Shows all the job's links to Excel: go to the cell, break the link, clean the workbook.
file.excelMacroAll: Runs the whole configured chain of Excel macros for one selected building.
file.excelMacroEveRakes: Adds the Eves and Rakes rows in descending length order and runs `A6_Eve_Rakes`.
file.excelMacroGables: Adds the selected Gables rows and runs the `A2_SQFT_calc` macro.
file.excelMacroOpenings: Adds openings from `Z158`, groups close windows by floor and runs `A5_Openings`.
file.excelMacroParapet: Adds the selected Parapet rows and runs the `A4_Parapet` macro.
file.excelMacroSqft: Adds the selected SQFT rows to the template and runs the `A2_SQFT_calc` macro.
file.excelMacroTrussHeel: Adds the selected Truss Heel rows and runs the `A2_SQFT_calc` macro.
file.excelMacroWalls: Adds the wall rows with floor groups and runs the `A3_Walls_Calc_AllGroup` macro.
file.exportCsv: Exports the measurement rows to a CSV file.
file.exportCurrentExcel: Writes the selected folder or takeoff into the active cell of the open Excel workbook.
file.exportCurrentExcelValues: Writes only the `Value` column for the same selection into the open Excel workbook.
file.exportExcel: Exports the selected or all measurements to `.xlsx`, columns J, K, L starting at J10.
file.exportPdf: Exports the selected or all sheets to one PDF.
file.exportTxt: Exports the selected or all measurements to the PlanSwift text format.
file.importPdf: Adds one or more PDFs to the current job.
file.importPdfFolder: Imports all PDFs from the selected folder and its subfolders into the current job.
file.importPdfTakeoffs: Brings PDF sheets over together with the PDF measurements and rulers into takeoffs.
file.importPlanSwift: Converts a PlanSwift job into a new OurPlanCore job, the source stays unchanged.
file.importPlanSwiftCurrent: Imports a PlanSwift job into the current job, into the `01. planswift` folder.
file.linkToExcel: Writes the selected takeoff's number into the active cell of the open workbook and keeps it there.
file.newJob: Creates a new OurPlanCore job from a folder of PDFs.
file.open: Opens the job picker; the button on the top bar also imports PDFs.
file.openJobsFolder: Opens a root folder that holds several jobs.
file.openOurPlan: Opens a portable `.ourplan` job file from disk.
file.openRecent: Opens the list of recent jobs for a quick pick.
file.resetExcelLinks: Removes all the job's links to Excel after a prompt. The values in the cells stay.
file.sampleJob: Creates and opens a sample tutorial job with hints.
file.save: Saves the current job with all its measurements.
file.saveAs: Saves the current job to a new location in the same format.
file.updateExcelLinks: Writes all pending link numbers, including into closed workbooks.
help.commands: Opens the command palette with a search across all app functions.
help.shortcuts: Opens or closes the app hotkeys help.
inbox.open: Opens the selected `AI Inbox` entry on its sheet.
layers.allOff: Turns off all PDF layers on the active sheet.
layers.allOn: Turns on all PDF layers on the active sheet.
layers.clearHighlight: Removes the highlight from the highlighted PDF layers on the sheet.
materials.extract: Extracts the materials and specifications found in the job's PDFs.
overlay.down: Shifts the overlaid sheet down by a small step.
overlay.fineDown: Shifts the overlaid sheet down by the finest step.
overlay.fineLeft: Shifts the overlaid sheet left by the finest step.
overlay.fineReset: Resets the shift, scale and rotation of the overlaid sheet, the `Shift` key variant.
overlay.fineRight: Shifts the overlaid sheet right by the finest step.
overlay.fineRotateLeft: Rotates the overlaid sheet left by the finest angle.
overlay.fineRotateRight: Rotates the overlaid sheet right by the finest angle.
overlay.fineScaleDown: Scales the overlaid sheet down by the finest step.
overlay.fineScaleUp: Scales the overlaid sheet up by the finest step.
overlay.fineUp: Shifts the overlaid sheet up by the finest step.
overlay.left: Shifts the overlaid sheet left by a small step.
overlay.reset: Resets the shift, scale and rotation of the overlaid sheet.
overlay.right: Shifts the overlaid sheet right by a small step.
overlay.rotateLeft: Rotates the overlaid sheet left by a small angle.
overlay.rotateRight: Rotates the overlaid sheet right by a small angle.
overlay.scaleDown: Scales the overlaid sheet down slightly by one step.
overlay.scaleUp: Scales the overlaid sheet up slightly by one step.
overlay.up: Shifts the overlaid sheet up by a small step.
pages.aiFillMetadata: Queues GPT for the sheets whose metadata was not found.
pages.autoFolders: Creates the standard sheet folder tree in the selected Pages folder.
pages.autoName: Shows and applies automatic sheet names from the PDF.
pages.autoNameScale: Shows and applies automatic sheet names and scales from the PDF.
pages.autoScale: Shows and applies automatic sheet scales from the PDF.
pages.blankSheet: Creates a blank sheet in the current job without a PDF.
pages.clearSelection: Clears the selection of all rows in the Pages tree.
pages.collapseTree: Collapses all folders in the Pages tree.
pages.copy: Copies the selected sheets or folders of the Pages tree to the clipboard.
pages.cut: Cuts the selected sheets or folders of the Pages tree for moving.
pages.delete: Deletes the selected sheets or folders from the Pages tree.
pages.detach: Opens the sheets selected in the Pages tree in separate windows.
pages.duplicate: Makes a copy of the selected Pages sheet or folder with the same name.
pages.expandTree: Expands all folders in the Pages tree.
pages.moveDown: Moves the selected sheet or folder one row down in the Pages tree.
pages.moveUp: Moves the selected sheet or folder one row up in the Pages tree.
pages.nameScaleSetup: Opens the window for setting the active sheet's name and scale by hand.
pages.newFolder: Creates a new folder inside the selected Pages folder.
pages.openTabs: Opens the sheets selected in the Pages tree in tabs.
pages.paste: Pastes the copied or cut sheets into the selected Pages folder.
pages.rename: Renames the selected sheet or folder in the Pages tree.
pages.repairLinks: Reattaches measurements to sheets after pages are renamed or imported.
pages.setScale: Sets one scale on the selected sheets or on the active sheet.
pages.sortArchStruct: Sorts A sheets into `Arch`, S sheets into `Struct`, the rest into others.
pages.sortAz: Sorts the contents of the selected Pages folder or the root alphabetically.
pages.sortSuffix: Sorts sheets with suffixes into the details, sections, units folders and orders the Pages root.
pages.sortZa: Sorts the contents of the selected Pages folder or the root in reverse alphabetical order.
pages.tileM2: Opens the selected sheets in separate windows and tiles them on the second monitor.
pages.undoDelete: Brings back the last deletion in the Pages tree.
panel|3d from takeoffs: Builds a 3D draft from the lines and areas of the Walls, Areas, Sqft levels.
panel|3d window: Opens a separate 3D window with rotation and saved marker points.
panel|accept 3d: Marks the 3D draft as reviewed job context.
panel|ai 3d sort: Sends takeoff data to OpenAI to sort out roles and levels, then builds a 3D draft.
panel|ai response: Adds an AI response to the observation by hand.
panel|auto roof: Queues AI roof marker candidates from the active sheet for review.
panel|build 3d draft: Builds a `model.json` 3D model draft from the current AI markers.
panel|crop: Opens the crop image of the selected source AI marker.
panel|jump: Opens the sheet the source marker is on.
panel|marker json: Opens the JSON file of the selected source AI marker.
panel|open json: Opens the 3D draft file `AI_Context/3d_massing/model.json` in an external program.
panel|open report: Opens the report on moving the PlanSwift job over.
panel|preview: Shows the current sheet's PDF as it will be exported; updates when the PDF Output settings change.
panel|project context: Opens the job context file for the AI.
panel|request json: Opens the JSON file of the AI request for this observation.
panel|review openings: Checks the door, window and opening markers before the 3D draft is accepted.
panel|review roof: Checks and saves the roof type, pitch, notes and guide points.
ribbon|add pages: Imports PDF pages into the current job.
ribbon|all: Shows the labels of all measurement types on the sheet.
ribbon|annotation line thickness: Sets the line width of marks on the sheet.
ribbon|area: Shows an area label on each area measurement.
ribbon|area boundary thickness: Sets the outline width of area measurements, from 0.25 to 4.0.
ribbon|area fill opacity: Sets the area fill opacity, from 0 to 100 percent.
ribbon|batch rename: Renames the selected sheets in sequence in one action.
ribbon|batch rotate: Rotates all selected sheets at once by a set angle.
ribbon|black vector: Draws crisp black vector lines over the sheet image at any zoom.
ribbon|box: Draws a simple rectangle mark that is not part of the measurements.
ribbon|choose a softer page background t: Picks a soft tint for the sheet background itself, from white to black.
ribbon|choose the background around the: Picks the background color around the sheet: white, gray or dark.
ribbon|close page: Closes the active sheet's tab in the viewer window.
ribbon|copy: Copies a PNG image of the active sheet to the clipboard.
ribbon|count: Shows a quantity label on each Count measurement.
ribbon|count marker size: Sets the size of the Count symbols, from 0.25 to 4.0.
ribbon|crop new page: Creates a new sheet from the part of the sheet visible right now.
ribbon|dark: Switches between the dark and light interface theme.
ribbon|fast pan/zoom: Simplifies overlays while panning and zooming, so heavy sheets move faster.
ribbon|ft / sf: Turns on imperial units ft, sf, ea; when off, metric.
ribbon|header: size: Picks a preset size for the header on the sheet.
ribbon|header: w/page: Makes the header grow and shrink with the sheet zoom; when off, the size is fixed.
ribbon|horizontal: Mirrors the active sheet horizontally, left to right.
ribbon|in progress: Moves the job card in Job Tracker to the `In Progress` status with an external command.
ribbon|invert: Inverts the active sheet's colors, white becomes black.
ribbon|joist: Shows the total and segment labels of the joist layouts in `Joist Area`.
ribbon|left: Rotates the active sheet 90 degrees to the left.
ribbon|legend: size: Picks a preset size for the legend on the sheet.
ribbon|legend: w/page: Makes the legend grow and shrink with the sheet zoom; when off, the size is fixed.
ribbon|level: Fits the sheet into the window and drops any half-drawn input.
ribbon|line: Shows a length label on each linear measurement.
ribbon|line measurement thickness: Sets the line width of linear measurements, from 0.25 to 4.0.
ribbon|mouse-wheel zoom step per notch: Sets the zoom step per mouse wheel notch, from 1.05 to 2.5.
ribbon|offset origin: Shifts the previously saved sheet origin by a set offset.
ribbon|open / import: Opens jobs, changes the jobs folder, creates a job or imports PDF and PlanSwift.
ribbon|pdf layers: Turns on the `PDF Layers` panel and layer detection on sheets; without it sheets load faster.
ribbon|pdf snap tab continuation radius: Sets the PDF snap continuation radius for the `Tab` key, from 4 to 96 pixels.
ribbon|pos: Picks the sheet corner or edge the legend is anchored to.
ribbon|right: Rotates the active sheet 90 degrees to the right.
ribbon|ruler screen thickness: Sets the on-screen ruler line width, from 0.5 to 6 pixels.
ribbon|set origin: Sets the center of the visible part of the sheet as the sheet origin.
ribbon|show: Shows or hides the legend on the active sheet.
ribbon|static image: Shows the sheet as a single 150 DPI image with no redraw on pan and zoom.
ribbon|style: Opens the markup tools with color and width choice.
ribbon|value label size: Sets the size of value labels on the sheet, from 0.25 to 3.0.
ribbon|vertical: Mirrors the active sheet vertically, top to bottom.
ribbon|viewport pdf render ram/quality p: Picks the PDF rendering memory and quality profile: `Balanced`, `High` or `Max`.
ribbon|w/ page: Makes the labels grow and shrink with the sheet zoom; when off, the size is fixed.
roof.cancel: Cancels the current guide or exits 3D roof mode.
roof.eave: Draws an eave line (`Eave`) in 3D roof guide mode.
roof.hip: Draws a hip line (`Hip`) in 3D roof guide mode.
roof.pitch: Draws a roof pitch guide (`Pitch`) in 3D roof guide mode.
roof.rake: Draws a rake line (`Rake`) in 3D roof guide mode.
roof.ridge: Draws a ridge line (`Ridge`) in 3D roof guide mode.
roof.undo: Removes the last placed point of a 3D roof guide.
roof.valley: Draws a valley line (`Valley`) in 3D roof guide mode.
settings|agent bridge: Sets up local assistant access to the open job.
settings|ai crop notes: Sets the format of the Tag and Size rows in notes from an AI table crop.
settings|auto link: Sets the threshold of small whole numbers that need a name to be linked.
settings|auto rename / scale: Sets up the sheet auto-naming and scale engine, suffix rules and AI title block reading.
settings|auto tree: Edits the tree of folders and takeoffs that `More > Auto Tree` builds.
settings|autosave recovery: Sets the autosave retry intervals after an error, globally or per job.
settings|background performance: Turns on background warm-up of the job's sheets and cleanup of unused raster cache.
settings|beam annotation line: Adds a markup line with a color and dimension offset to each new Beam.
settings|blank sheets: Sets the default blank sheet size and the paper presets.
settings|connect another computer: Connects a second computer to the workspace with a one-time code.
settings|current project: Shows the path and total size of the open job.
settings|defaults: Collects the general settings: wheel zoom, background warm-up, raster cache, DPI, the Beam line.
settings|details: Shows the detailed job storage analysis report.
settings|deterministic auto name / scale: Picks the naming and scale engine preset and tests the rules on the selected sheets.
settings|display & export defaults: Opens the Viewport, Display and PDF Output ribbons with the default settings.
settings|evidence, confidence, and prese: Sets the evidence sources, confidence thresholds and protection of already reviewed names and scales.
settings|excel actions: Sets up the XL strip buttons and the order of the `ALL` export steps.
settings|excel macro actions: Lists the XL strip buttons and the sequence of steps for `ALL`.
settings|floor folder matching: Sets the words that make a folder count as a floor, for example `1, 1st, first`.
settings|framing folders → excel blocks: Maps the framing folders in the tree to row blocks in the Excel workbook.
settings|from pages: Edits the top Takeoffs folders that are created from the sheet structure.
settings|keyboard shortcuts: Opens the hotkeys editor, globally or per job.
settings|learned rules (lower-priority e: Stores learned sheet naming rules, globally or per job, at the lowest priority.
settings|levels: Lists the levels: dot label, floor folders for walls, framing, shear and name tags.
settings|link to excel behaviour: Sets how the link writes to an open and a closed workbook, workbook copies, pauses.
settings|modules: Turns app modules on and off and sets the command for Job Tracker.
settings|page folders: Edits the standard Pages folders that `Auto Folders` creates, for the Auto, COM, EWP templates.
settings|pdf editable export (adobe): Sets which measurements sit in the PDF as objects for editing in Adobe Acrobat.
settings|project format: Shows the storage format of the open job; new jobs are always a single `.ourplan` file.
settings|project storage: Shows where the job takes up space and safely compacts `snap.json`.
settings|projects: Lists shared jobs: share the current one, open, resolve conflicts, apply shared presets.
settings|review-only findings: Lists job size findings that need a manual check.
settings|rows: Lists the routing dot rows; the U row sends all floors into units with one dot.
settings|safe compact preview: Shows what can be safely compacted in the job before compacting.
settings|sheet legend: Sets the names and order of the automatic legend blocks by Takeoffs folder, globally or per job.
settings|sheet manager raster dpi preset: Sets the values of the DPI buttons in Sheet Manager, from 72 to 400.
settings|sheet takeoff routing: Sets the levels, the W, F, S, U dots and the folders where a new measurement goes.
settings|sort a/s: Edits the rules for sorting A sheets into `Arch` and S sheets into `Struct`.
settings|sort d/sec/wt: Edits the rules by which a sheet name suffix sends the sheet to a folder.
settings|storage breakdown: Shows how much space each part of the job takes.
settings|suffix generation rules (first: Lists the sheet suffix rules; the first enabled matching row wins.
settings|takeoff colors: Sets a fixed color for takeoffs with an exact name, for example `bft`.
settings|takeoff name routing: Sets the rules by which the name or tool sends a measurement into its folder.
settings|takeoff templates: Stores tree and takeoff presets for inserting from the Templates tab.
settings|terminals: Sets up the Claude and Codex terminals: profile, width, effort and context.
settings|tool destinations: Sets the destination folder for the measurements of each tool.
settings|tree display: Shows the section and point rows under takeoffs in the Takeoffs tree.
settings|viewport interaction: Sets the mouse wheel zoom step in the sheet window.
settings|walls extras: sheathing, shear: Sets up the Excel export of sheathing, shear walls, shaft walls, units and balconies.
settings|workspace: Sets up the server, device, sync and work from a second computer.
sheet.overlay: Picks a suitable sheet to overlay on the active one.
sheet.overlayBatch: Matches pairs of base and overlay sheets across the whole job.
sheet.overlayPoints: Aligns the active sheet's overlay by pairs of points.
strip|configure the command strip (gear): Opens the icon strip setup: which commands to show on it.
takeoffs.activeFind: Scrolls the Takeoffs tree to the active takeoff.
takeoffs.activeNext: Makes the next takeoff in the target list active.
takeoffs.activePrevious: Makes the previous takeoff in the target list active.
takeoffs.activeProperties: Opens the properties of the active takeoff for editing.
takeoffs.activeRecord: Starts or stops recording into the active takeoff.
takeoffs.activeSheetNext: Makes active the next takeoff that has measurements on the active sheet.
takeoffs.autoTree: Creates the standard takeoff folder tree for a new job.
takeoffs.collapseTree: Collapses all folders in the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.copy: Copies the selected takeoffs or folders of the Takeoffs tree to the clipboard.
takeoffs.cut: Cuts the selected takeoffs or folders of the Takeoffs tree for moving.
takeoffs.delete: Deletes the selected nodes from the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.duplicate: Makes a copy of the selected Takeoffs takeoff or folder with the same name.
takeoffs.expandTree: Expands all folders in the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.fromPages: Creates top takeoff folders from the names of Pages sheets and folders typed in capitals.
takeoffs.moveDown: Moves the selected takeoff, folder or section one row down in the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.moveUp: Moves the selected takeoff, folder or section one row up in the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.newFolder: Creates a takeoff folder in the selected folder or in the root.
takeoffs.newItem: Creates a takeoff in the selected folder or in the root.
takeoffs.paste: Pastes the copied or cut takeoffs into the selected Takeoffs folder.
takeoffs.refresh: Rereads the Takeoffs tree from the current job folder.
takeoffs.rename: Renames the selected takeoff, folder or section in the Takeoffs tree.
takeoffs.roofBase: Creates a 3D roof base from the selected area measurements.
takeoffs.showSections: Selects on the sheet the measurements of the selected Takeoffs tree sections.
takeoffs.sortAz: Sorts the contents of the selected Takeoffs folder or the root alphabetically.
takeoffs.sortDetails: Groups `1/A501` style nodes by the sheet after the slash, in the Pages tree order.
takeoffs.sortWalls: Sorts the walls in the folder and subfolders: ext, corr, dem, then 2x6 and 2x4 sizes.
takeoffs.sortZa: Sorts the contents of the selected Takeoffs folder or the root in reverse alphabetical order.
takeoffs.undoDelete: Brings back the last deletion in the Takeoffs tree.
tool.area: Records area measurements into a takeoff.
tool.areaCut: Cuts a hole inside the selected area measurement.
tool.beam: Measures the beam length, creates a Count takeoff and places the first point.
tool.count: Places count points into a takeoff.
tool.drawBox: Draws a rectangle mark on the sheet that is not part of the measurements.
tool.drawLine: Draws a markup line; with one `Joist Area` selected it turns on continuous Extra Joists.
tool.highlight: Draws a semi-transparent mark on the sheet, like a highlighter.
tool.joistArea: Creates a `Joist Area` takeoff and records areas into it.
tool.line: Records linear measurements into a takeoff.
tool.note: Writes a text note on the active sheet.
tool.openings: Measures the opening box, creates a Count takeoff named by size and places a point in the center.
tool.pan: Moves the sheet with the left mouse button; the right button moves it too.
tool.pitch: Draws a slope line by two points and shows the pitch per 12.
tool.pointAlongLine: Places Count points along the selected lines at a set spacing.
tool.ruler: Measures a distance temporarily, without creating a measurement.
tool.scale: Sets the sheet scale from a calibration line of known length.
tool.select: Turns on box selection and measurement editing.
tool.similar: Finds similar symbols on the sheet and adds the verified points to a Count takeoff.
tool.toggleBox: Turns on `Box` mode: line, area and cutout are drawn as a rectangle by two corners.
tool.toggleOrtho: Turns on `Ortho` mode, horizontal and vertical only; `Shift` turns it on temporarily.
tool.togglePdfSnap: Turns snapping to PDF vector corners and points on or off.
tool.toggleRecord: Turns recording with the current measuring tool on or off.
tool.toggleSnap: Turns snapping to points of existing measurements on or off.
toolstrip|area: Creates a new Area takeoff and starts recording; for an existing takeoff press `Record`.
toolstrip|beam: Measures the beam length, creates a Count takeoff and places the first point.
toolstrip|box: Draws lines and areas as a rectangle by two opposite corners.
toolstrip|break: Breaks the selected lines into separate segments; the total length does not change, `Ctrl+Z` brings them back.
toolstrip|break h/v: Sorts the horizontal and vertical line segments into two new takeoffs.
toolstrip|combine: Combines two or more areas: union, subtraction, intersection, overlap removal, division.
toolstrip|count: Creates a new Count takeoff and starts recording; for an existing takeoff press `Record`.
toolstrip|cut: Cuts holes in areas or erases pieces of lines; `F9` turns on the box.
toolstrip|default count display for newl: Picks how the points of new Count takeoffs are shown by default.
toolstrip|ends: Places Count points at both ends of each segment of the selected lines.
toolstrip|flip h: Mirrors the selected measurements and marks horizontally.
toolstrip|flip v: Mirrors the selected measurements and marks vertically.
toolstrip|include takeoff comments in ex: Adds takeoff and measurement comments to the Excel export; off by default.
toolstrip|j area: Creates a new `Joist Area` takeoff and starts recording the area.
toolstrip|line: Creates a new Line takeoff and starts recording; for an existing takeoff press `Record`.
toolstrip|merge: Merges the selected takeoffs from all sheets or the selected measurement segments.
toolstrip|open: Measures the opening box, creates a Count takeoff and places a point in the center.
toolstrip|ortho: Limits drawing and editing to horizontal and vertical; `Shift` turns it on temporarily.
toolstrip|p line: Places Count points along the selected lines at a set spacing.
toolstrip|pan: Turns on the tool for moving the sheet with the left mouse button.
toolstrip|pdf: Turns on snapping to PDF vector corners and points.
toolstrip|pitch: Draws a line by two points and shows the roof pitch per 12.
toolstrip|presets: Opens the list of common drawing scales for a quick pick.
toolstrip|repeat beam: Measures beams one after another, each gets its own takeoff; `Esc` stops.
toolstrip|repeat line: Creates a Line takeoff and draws separate two-point segments one after another; `Esc` stops.
toolstrip|reset rotate selection: Returns the selection rotate slider to the center for the next adjustment.
toolstrip|ruler: Places a ruler dimension mark on the sheet that is not part of the measurements.
toolstrip|ruler sheet visibility: Hides or shows all ruler marks on this sheet.
toolstrip|scale: Turns on the tool for setting the sheet scale from a known length.
toolstrip|select: Selects measurements with a box; `Ctrl+C` copies, `Ctrl+V` pastes.
toolstrip|set: Applies the scale typed in the field to the active sheet.
toolstrip|snap: Turns on snapping to points of existing measurements.
toolstrip|split: Splits takeoffs across all sheets or moves the selected measurements and points out separately.
view.3dManager: Switches to the workspace with a clean 3D model view.
view.3dTab: Opens the 3D wall view tab in the right panel.
view.addBookmark: Saves the active sheet with the current zoom and position as a named bookmark.
view.aiManager: Switches to the AI manager with incoming requests and markers.
view.collapseTrees: Collapses all folders in the Pages and Takeoffs trees.
view.estimatingTab: Opens the `Estimating` tab in the workspace side panel.
view.fit: Fits the whole active sheet into the viewer window.
view.hideSelectedTakeoffs: Hides on the sheet the whole takeoff of each selected measurement; the visibility toggle brings it back.
view.mainView: Switches to the workspace with the sheet and the measuring tools.
view.materialsManager: Switches to the materials extraction workspace.
view.quickCalc: Shows or hides the slide-out calculator that works in feet and inches.
view.reportBuilder: Switches to the table-style report builder.
view.sheetManager: Switches to the sheet table with PDF metadata.
view.takeoffManager: Switches to the takeoff manager workspace.
view.takeoffsTab: Opens the `Takeoffs` tab in the workspace side panel.
view.terminal: Shows or hides the Codex and Claude terminals with the sheet, crop and bookmark context.
view.toggleInbox: Collapses or expands the `AI Inbox` panel.
view.toggleTakeoffVisibility: Hides or shows all measurements on the active sheet; new measurements stay visible.
view.toggleTheme: Switches between the light and dark interface theme.
view.viewportBackground: Opens the preset background colors under the sheet.
view.zoomIn: Zooms the active sheet in by one zoom step.
view.zoomOut: Zooms the active sheet out by one zoom step.
workspace|+ new: Opens the menu for creating sheets and folders in the Pages tree.
workspace|add: Adds one more overlay layer to the active sheet.
workspace|add missing codes: Adds a legend row for each post, beam and header code that is missing from it.
workspace|ai crop +: Draws a crop for the AI and passes its PNG into the terminal context.
workspace|ai inbox: Opens `AI Inbox` and the AI manager.
workspace|analyze: Reads the PDF text and layers and shows the sheet metadata found.
workspace|apply: Applies tracing of the active PDF layer at the point under the pointer.
workspace|apply checked: Applies the checked rename and scale rows to the job.
workspace|apply walls: Applies the A3 wall block rule to the selected rows in columns J and K.
workspace|attach ▾: Attaches an already open Git Bash or mintty window to the panel.
workspace|auto: Restores adaptive sheet DPI in Sheet Manager; in 3D builds walls, slabs and roofs by itself.
workspace|auto fit: Automatically aligns the overlaid sheet with the active one.
workspace|auto name: Shows the proposed automatic sheet names before applying.
workspace|auto scale: Shows the proposed automatic sheet scales before applying.
workspace|blue: Makes the overlaid sheet blue to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|cancel: Cancels the background raster work after the current sheet.
workspace|choose / replace: Picks or replaces the sheet that is overlaid on the active one.
workspace|choose custom color: Opens a custom color picker for the overlaid sheet.
workspace|claude: Switches the terminal panel to the conversation with Claude.
workspace|clean: Deletes unused raster versions of the selected sheets, the active raster stays.
workspace|clear: Removes rafters from all roofs in 3D; in the XL legend clears and saves the text.
workspace|close detached sheets on monit: Closes all separate sheet windows on the second monitor.
workspace|close other sheets and keep th: Closes all other tabs and separate sheet windows, keeps the sheet in the main window.
workspace|codex: Switches the terminal panel to the conversation with Codex.
workspace|context: Opens the live sheet context file for the assistant.
workspace|deepseek: Switches the terminal panel to DeepSeek through the local Codex CLI.
workspace|delete empty: Deletes all takeoffs with no measurements; `Ctrl+Z` brings back the whole batch.
workspace|detach: Opens the selected sheets in separate windows.
workspace|detach terminal to its own win: Moves the terminal into a separate window, the conversation continues.
workspace|edit by points: Aligns the overlay by pairs of points on the two sheets.
workspace|export: Opens the menu for saving and exporting quantities.
workspace|extract: Extracts material details from the current job's source PDFs.
workspace|filter ai markers by sample ki: Filters AI markers in `AI Inbox` by sample kind.
workspace|filter ai markers by type: Filters AI markers in `AI Inbox` by type.
workspace|find best: Finds the best sheet in the job to overlay on the active one.
workspace|first off: Opens the selected raster sheets the regular way, through the PDF and preview.
workspace|first on: Opens the selected raster sheets right away from the prepared image as the first frame.
workspace|fit: Fits the whole 3D scene into the viewer window.
workspace|folder: Opens the job folder with the material extraction results.
workspace|folder template mode: Picks the folder template for Pages and Takeoffs: `Auto`, `COM` or `EWP`.
workspace|front: Shows the 3D model from the front, like a building elevation.
workspace|full: Switches the dimming in `Layer Trace`: full, muted or off; `Tab` does the same.
workspace|generate roof: Builds ridges, hips and valleys from the saved roof edge pitches.
workspace|gray: Makes the overlaid sheet gray to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|green: Makes the overlaid sheet green to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|hide panel: Hides the terminal panel, the conversations continue.
workspace|hide the excel legend panel: Hides the Excel legend panel opened with the `LG` button.
workspace|iso: Turns the 3D model to an isometric view from the side and above.
workspace|json: Opens the full JSON of the material extraction result.
workspace|layer trace: Highlights the selected PDF layer and traces its lines into a measurement.
workspace|load: Looks for PDF layers on the active sheet on demand.
workspace|magenta: Makes the overlaid sheet magenta to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|manual: Switches between manual tracing and tracing by PDF layer on the sheet.
workspace|match page folder case exactly: Matches Pages folders with exact upper and lower case.
workspace|match takeoff folder case exac: Matches Takeoffs folders with exact upper and lower case.
workspace|more: Opens the menu of extra actions for the Takeoffs panel, the active takeoff or `AI Inbox`.
workspace|move active layer down: Moves the active overlay layer one position down.
workspace|move active layer up: Moves the active overlay layer one position up.
workspace|name+scale: Shows the proposed sheet names and scales together.
workspace|new blank job - start empty: Creates an empty job, sheets can be added later.
workspace|new job from pdfs - import a f: Creates a job from a folder of PDF drawings.
workspace|next match: Puts in the next suitable candidate sheet for the overlay.
workspace|open: Opens the sheets selected in the Pages tree.
workspace|open a recent job - recently u: Opens a job from the recently used list.
workspace|open estimating: Opens a separate window with the full `Estimating` table of all measurements.
workspace|open json: Opens the JSON file with the PDF metadata for checking.
workspace|open sample job - explore a de: Opens the built-in sample job to get to know the app.
workspace|open sheet: Opens the selected sheet in the main workspace.
workspace|open source: Opens the source sheet that is overlaid on the active one.
workspace|open tabs: Opens the selected sheets in tabs of the viewer window.
workspace|options: Opens the raster settings: format, preparation, first frame, cleanup and cancel.
workspace|orange: Makes the overlaid sheet orange to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|paste context: Pastes the context message into the terminal without `Enter`, you send it yourself.
workspace|pdf: Turns off raster rendering for the selected sheets, they are drawn from the PDF.
workspace|pick faces: Turns rafters on or off on a roof plane with a click on it in 3D.
workspace|prepare: Prepares the raster cache at the last selected DPI without changing the sheet mode.
workspace|rafter member size: Sets the rafter size; the depth goes under the roof plane, the walls are trimmed.
workspace|rafter spacing o.c: Sets the rafter spacing on center, measured horizontally along the eave.
workspace|reasoning effort for the next: Picks the reasoning effort for the next launch: Quick, Balanced or Deep.
workspace|red: Makes the overlaid sheet red to tell it apart from the base sheet.
workspace|refresh: Rereads the table of the current manager: sheets, takeoffs, report, materials or AI.
workspace|refresh pages tree: Rereads the Pages tree from the current job folder.
workspace|reload: Reloads `TemplateCom.xlsm` into the report builder table.
workspace|remove: Removes the active overlay from the current sheet.
workspace|report sheet: Creates a `Materials Report` sheet for copying from the job's existing sheets.
workspace|reset: Resets the 3D camera view or the shift, scale and rotation of the overlaid sheet.
workspace|return bookmarks to the tab li: Returns the bookmarks panel to the tab list.
workspace|return templates to the tab li: Returns the templates panel to the tab list.
workspace|rows csv: Opens the rows of the materials found as CSV.
workspace|save for job: Saves the legend text for the current job.
workspace|select edge: Selects the lower roof edges on the sheet; the pitch of each edge is saved in the side panel.
workspace|set active: Makes the selected takeoff the active drawing target.
workspace|setup: Opens the menu for setting up and sorting sheets in the Pages tree.
workspace|sheet: Picks a takeoff from those already measured on this sheet.
workspace|sheet manager raster format bo: Picks the raster cache format: `Auto` with WebP, `WebP` or `PNG` for difficult PDFs.
workspace|summary csv: Opens the summary of materials by group as CSV.
workspace|terminal actions: Opens the terminal menu in a narrow panel: move it to a window or open the settings.
workspace|tile m2: Opens the selected sheets in separate tiled windows on the second monitor.
workspace|toggle vertical tile m2 layout: Switches the tile layout on the second monitor to vertical and back.
workspace|top: Shows the 3D model from above, like a building plan.
workspace|whole roof: Lays out rafters on all planes of all built roofs.
workspace|▶ run: Starts or continues the assistant with the selected E-Wood shortcut.
xl|balconies (bl): Creates a list block for each balcony, deck and porch size from the SQFT areas.
xl|beams (bm): Replaces the Beam rows in each framing list of the selected building from the legend.
xl|details (dt): Puts each floor's detail lines into columns J, K, L once.
xl|framing (fr): Exports the posts, beams, joists, headers and details of the selected building into the framing lists.
xl|headers (hd): Rebuilds the header rows in the wall block one floor below each framing floor.
xl|joists (js): Replaces the Joist rows in each framing list; Extra joists of the same length are added to the row.
xl|legend (lg): Opens the job legend used to export Beams, Posts and Headers.
xl|posts (ps): Replaces the Posts rows in each framing list of the selected building from the legend.
xl|shaft walls (shf): Adds or updates the Shaft walls block with panels and CH and J profiles.
xl|shear walls (sw): Fills the Shear Walls and Holdowns rows in the wall block of each floor.
xl|sheathing (sh): Runs the `A7_walls_sheathing` macro and keeps one sheathing system based on column J or the legend.
xl|stairs (st): Adds the stair measurements before the Subfloor row of each framing list.
xl|units (un): Builds the typical unit table with counts by floor and `SUMPRODUCT` totals.
